reason: A workspace file browser and editor with text-file read/write support, multi-file tabs, and Markdown preview; the primary purpose is local file management within the host web interface.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中浏览、编辑和保存工作区文本文件，并提供多文件标签页与 Markdown 预览。
summaries.en: Browse, edit, and save workspace text files in DeepSeek Harness Web with multi-file tabs and Markdown preview.

capabilities: Reads text files through host file-system services
Edits and writes text files with version and conflict checks
Previews Markdown with GitHub-flavored rendering and syntax highlighting
Provides a browser-based panel with tabs, search, resizing, and settings
